copy.tagline: 在应用中集成Webex聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在应用里接入Webex聊天功能。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Webex chat into your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Webex chat to your app.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能为项目添加 Webex 频道:复制适配器代码、注册通道、安装依赖、执行构建和集成测试,并引导填入 Webex bot 令牌与 webhook 密钥。
howto.when: 当用户要求接入 Webex 频道、添加 Webex 机器人,或在 /setup 流程中要配置 Webex 时,Claude 会执行。

say.text: 给项目加上 Webex 频道
say.note: Claude 会复制适配器、注册、装依赖并跑测试。

say.text: 帮我配好 Webex bot 令牌和 webhook 密钥
帮我检查 Webex 适配器有没有装好
say.note: Claude 会运行注册测试,必要时看日志排错。

howto.what_en: Claude adds Webex channel support: copies the adapter, registers it, installs the pinned dependency, builds, runs the integration test, and prompts for the bot token and webhook secret.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a Webex channel or bot, or during the /setup flow when Webex integration is requested.

say_en.text: Add Webex channel to this project.
say_en.note: Claude copies, registers, installs, and tests the adapter.

say_en.text: Set up my Webex bot token and webhook secret.
say_en.note: Claude prompts for both and writes them to .env, keeping existing values.

say_en.text: Check if the Webex adapter is installed correctly.
say_en.note: Claude runs the registration test and inspects the log if needed.
